title: Can parents participate in therapy sessions at Pinnacle Blooms?
metaTitle: Parent Involvement in Therapy Sessions at Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Pinnacle Blooms Network encourages active parental involvement in therapy sessions for sustained progress in the behavior of children with Autism and related conditions.
html: Certainly! At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we firmly believe in the transformative power of family involvement. We deeply value and encourage parents to be a part of the therapy sessions. We recognize that parents are key in reinforcing learnt behaviors and hence encourage active participation, ensuring sustained progress in the child's behavior.
